Name: Loops Consult
Description:
Loops Consult — About

Loops Consult provides practical automation and engineering support for industrial operations.
The focus is on helping plants modernise control systems, improve process efficiency, and meet compliance requirements — with clear documentation and reliable design practices.

1. Industrial Automation & Control

* Development of Functional Descriptions (FDS/SRS) and control documentation for new or upgraded equipment.
* Creation of I/O lists and control narratives to standardise logic and improve troubleshooting.
* Design of PLC/SCADA networks and communication layouts (Ethernet/IP, Modbus, Profibus and fieldbuses).
* Integration of SCADA and historian systems, including tag structures, alarms, and production reports.
* Review and optimisation of VFD and Safety PLC installations for better performance and uptime.

2. Industrial Processes

* Design and updates of P&ID diagrams for utilities and process lines.
* Utility balancing (water, energy, steam) and improvement of system efficiency.
* Support for expansion or retrofit projects, ensuring automation, electrical, and mechanical systems align.
* Application of data analysis and simple machine learning tools to detect trends and improve process control.

3. Compliance & Standardisation

* Development of tag and naming standards for PLCs and SCADA systems.
* Compliance checks with AS/NZS 3000, AS/NZS 4024, and IEC 61131-3 requirements.
* Preparation of audit-ready documentation for safety and energy systems.
* Guidance to bring legacy control systems in line with modern standards.

Approach:
* Clear, practical engineering — focused on safety, reliability, and long-term maintainability.

Loops Consult works alongside your team to make automation simpler, safer, and easier to support.
